29. ASTHMA IN PREGNANCY
•Commonest chronic condition 4 – 12%.

Breathlessness:

•If RR is > 24 (normal 12 – 20).

Causes of breathlessness:

1.Anxiety.
2.Hyperventilation.
3.Respiratory diseases:
-Asthma
-Chest infection.
-VTE – embolism.
-AF embolism.
-pneumothorax.
4.CVS:
-Arrhythmias
-IHD
-Cardiomyopathy.
5.Endocrine disorders:
-DM + DKA.
-Thyrotoxicosis.
6.Hematological:
-Anemia.
-Hge.
7.Renal diseases.

Effect of Pregnancy on Asthma:

•Unchanged/ worsen/ improve.
•Severe – worsen 60%. Depend upon
•Mild – worsen 10%. severity.
•Worsening 24 – 36 weeks.
•Commonest triggering factor.
-Viral infections.
-Non-compliant to treatment = 29%.
•Cortisol
•Progesterone
•F2α | Worsen.

1/5th: Exacerbation in labour/ delivery.

•Ergometrine, prostaglandins => bronchospasm
•F2α = intra myometrial can be given avoid I/V, I/M
•Avoid NSAIDS

MDT:

•Respiratory physician and Obstetrician.
1.Step 3 treatment and above.
2.Mod – severe disease.

Effect of Asthma on Pregnancy:

•Pre-eclampsia
•IUGR
•PTL
•Low birth

Steroids => cleft lip = 0.3%.

Management:

-Acute – admission.
-OPD – step wise management

Step 1: (Mild intermittent)

 

•Inhalation B2 Agonist.
•Short acting:
-Salbutamol
-Terbutaline.

Step 2: (Regular preventer)

 

•Inhalation steroid
•Add 200 – 800mcg.
-Beclomethasone.
-Budesonide.
•400 appropriate.

Step 3: (initial add on)

•Add LABA long acting B2 Agonist
-Salmeterol.
-Formoterol.

Long acting B2 Agonist

Good control sub optional no response

 

Continue LABA - Stop LABA

+ - Steroid

Dose of inhaled steroid to still uncontrol. 800mcg/day.

 

1. Add leukotriene

2. Theophylline

(Drug level monitoring.)

Step 4: (Persistent poor control)

 

•Inhaled steroid up to 200mcg/lit.
•Add 4th Drug:
-Theophylline
-B2 – Agonist.
-Leukotriene receptor Blockers.

Step 5: (Continuous/ Frequent use of oral steroids)

 

•Oral steroids.
•Maintain high dose steroids.
•Refer to specialist.

Drugs of Asthma:

•All drugs safe in pregnancy + B.F:
-Steroids – cleft lip or palate < 0.3%.
•Anti IgE:
-Biological therapy not suitable in pregnancy.
-Given in specialist center.

•Montelukast:
-Limited date.

Avoid in Asthma:

•Labetalol – HTN.
•Ulipristal acetate – EC.
•Ergometrine – PPH.
•NSAIDS – pain.
•F2α – intra myometrial can be given but no I/V or I/M

WHO recommended 6m0 B.F to reduce childhood asthma.
